application_credentials.description: Create an app registration in [Microsoft Entra]({console_url}). Select personal Microsoft accounts, add the Home Assistant OAuth redirect URI shown during setup as a Mobile and desktop application redirect, and leave the client secret blank for this public-client PKCE flow.

user.title: Connect Microsoft email
user.description: Choose how much email content Home Assistant may read. Metadata-only requests basic message properties only. Short summaries require the broader Mail.Read permission and retrieve message text locally. Your selected Outlook folder is a query filter, not a Microsoft-enforced permission boundary.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize Microsoft email
reauth_confirm.description: Microsoft authorization has expired or been revoked. Reconnect the account to continue.

abort.already_configured: A Microsoft mailbox is already configured.
